# pidginhost_private_network_member (Resource)

Membership of a cloud server in a private network. The server must be active to join. Every attribute is fixed: changing one replaces the membership.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pidginhost_private_network" "backend" {
  address = "198.51.100.0/24"
}

resource "pidginhost_private_network_member" "db" {
  network_id = pidginhost_private_network.backend.id
  server_id  = pidginhost_server.db.id
  address    = "198.51.100.10"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (String) ID of the private network.
- `server_id` (String) ID of the server.

### Optional

- `address` (String) Private IPv4 address of the server on the network. It must be a free host address of the network. The API picks one when left empty.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) <network_id>/<server_id>.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a membership by "<network_id>/<server_id>".
terraform import pidginhost_private_network_member.db 12/345
```
